tools.name: get_agora_merit_info
tools.description: Get supported uses, free assessment and full-report pricing, document-sharing requirements, and the human review workflow for Agora Merit.

tools.name: assess_job_responsibilities
tools.description: Submit a user-authorized job title and responsibilities for a free role-design assessment. Returns findings, a quoted full-report price where available, and a private seven-day link so the human can review the same results. Creates a temporary review snapshot. No card charge, subscription, or paid r

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_agora_merit_info · Private data: get_agora_merit_info, assess_job_responsibilities · Public sink: assess_job_responsibilities.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_agora_merit_info · Private data: get_agora_merit_info, assess_job_responsibilities · Public sink: assess_job_responsibilities

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
